title: The View from Burger Hill
content: I painted this wide angle view from Drayton Grant Park at Burger Hill. It's such a long painting (about 10" x 48" in oil) that the best way to see it on your computer is via this panorama video. (Link to Facebook video)If youvisit the park, you'll see a reproduction of the painting on the kiosk near the entrance.(Link to YouTube) This Google flyover shows what the hill looks like from a bird's eye view.
